import json, sys, math

from research_sdk import Client

wb=json.load(open('/workspace/whitebox.json'))
jobs=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))
man=json.load(open(sys.argv[2]))
dom_w=man['domain_aggregations']
scores={}
for m,j in jobs.items():
    s=c.status(j['id'])
    if s.get('status') in ('queued','running'): print(m,'not done'); continue
    rows={r['id']:r for r in s['result']['items']}
    ds={}
    for d,spec in dom_w.items():
        num=den=0; miss=0
        for iid,w in spec['weights'].items():
            r=rows.get(iid)
            if r is None or r.get('score') is None: miss+=1; continue
            num+=w*r['score']; den+=w
        ds[d]=(num/den if den else None, miss)
    scores[m]=ds
    print(m, {d:(round(v[0],3) if v[0] is not None else None, v[1]) for d,v in ds.items()}, 'cost', s.get('cost',{}).get('charged_usd'))
def pearson(x,y):
    n=len(x); mx=sum(x)/n; my=sum(y)/n
    sx=math.sqrt(sum((a-mx)**2 for a in x)); sy=math.sqrt(sum((b-my)**2 for b in y))
    return sum((a-mx)*(b-my) for a,b in zip(x,y))/(sx*sy) if sx>0 and sy>0 else float('nan')
for d,targets in wb['domains'].items():
    for t in targets:
        labs=wb['targets'][t]['scores']
        ms=[m for m in scores if m in labs and scores[m][d][0] is not None]
        if len(ms)>=3:
            x=[scores[m][d][0] for m in ms]; y=[labs[m] for m in ms]
            print(d, t, 'n=%d'%len(ms), 'pearson=%.3f'%pearson(x,y), list(zip(ms,[round(v,3) for v in x],y)))

label: Research notes
text: Development-08's issue is a cheap model overthinking even simple SciCode/LiveCodeBench items past 16k tokens, so tight caps would unfairly zero it out. I'll set middle-ground caps, trim to 110 questions, add an explicit output-limit note to prompts, and validate the revised suite on the expensive model.
